description: Source code implementing LittleFS filesystem integration for Zephyr RTOS, including mounting, formatting, file operations, and configuration initialization.

methods.name: littlefs_open
methods.description: Opens a file with specified path and flags, allocating necessary resources.

methods.name: littlefs_close
methods.description: Closes an open file and releases associated resources.

methods.name: littlefs_unlink
methods.description: Removes a file at the specified path.

methods.name: littlefs_rename
methods.description: Renames a file from one path to another.

methods.name: littlefs_read
methods.description: Reads data from an open file.

methods.name: littlefs_write
methods.description: Writes data to an open file.

methods.name: littlefs_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in an open file.

methods.name: littlefs_tell
methods.description: Returns current position in an open file.

methods.name: littlefs_truncate
methods.description: Truncates an open file to a specified length.

methods.name: littlefs_sync
methods.description: Synchronizes an open file's state with storage.

methods.name: littlefs_mkdir
methods.description: Creates a directory at the specified path.

methods.name: littlefs_opendir
methods.description: Opens a directory for reading entries.

methods.name: littlefs_readdir
methods.description: Reads next entry in an open directory.

methods.name: littlefs_closedir
methods.description: Closes an open directory.

methods.name: littlefs_stat
methods.description: Retrieves information about a file or directory.

methods.name: littlefs_statvfs
methods.description: Retrieves filesystem statistics.

methods.name: littlefs_mkfs
methods.description: Formats a storage device with LittleFS filesystem.

methods.name: littlefs_mount
methods.description: Mounts the LittleFS filesystem.

methods.name: littlefs_unmount
methods.description: Unmounts the LittleFS filesystem.

methods.name: littlefs_init
methods.description: Initializes the LittleFS subsystem and mounts filesystems.
